_comment: OPT_1_USED was set by nothing, and the OPT effect itself was invented -- the card has no 'look at the top card' text. Galvanize (the keyword in the printed text) is 'when this defends, you may destroy an item you control; if you do, +2{d}'. A MAY block makes 'if you do' fall out on declining, so no flag is needed.

effects.prompt: Galvanize: destroy an item you control to give this +2{d}?
